job.job_description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced AI Engineer with 5+ years of industry experience in designing, developing, and deploying scalable AI/ML solutions within AWS cloud environments. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, cloud-native architectures, MLOps, and enterprise-scale application integration.

The candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams including Data Engineering, Cloud, DevOps, Product, and Business stakeholders to deliver intelligent solutions that drive business transformation.

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models and intelligent applications on AWS cloud platform.
Build scalable and production-ready machine learning pipelines using AWS native services.
Develop and optimize Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) based solutions for enterprise use cases.
Work on model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment strategies.
Implement MLOps best practices for continuous integration, deployment, monitoring, and governance of AI models.
Collaborate with Data Engineers and Architects to design data pipelines and AI solution architecture.
Integrate AI services with enterprise applications, APIs, and cloud platforms.
Ensure scalability, security, reliability, and performance optimization of AI workloads.
Conduct model performance analysis, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities.
Participate in technical solutioning, architecture discussions, and client interactions.
Mentor junior AI/ML engineers and contribute to technical best practices.
Stay updated with latest advancements in AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and AWS ecosystem.

Roles and Responsibilities
Required Skills & Technical Expertise AI / Machine Learning
Strong expertise in:
Machine Learning Algorithms
Deep Learning
NLP (Natural Language Processing)
Generative AI
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Prompt Engineering
Model Fine-Tuning
Programming Skills
Proficiency in:
Python
PyTorch
TensorFlow
Scikit-learn
LangChain / LlamaIndex
FastAPI / Flask
AWS Cloud Expertise
Hands-on experience with AWS services including:
Amazon SageMaker
AWS Bedrock
Lambda
EC2
S3
Glue
Redshift
API Gateway
ECS / EKS
CloudWatch
IAM
Step Functions
MLOps & DevOps
Experience with:
CI/CD pipelines
Docker
Kubernetes
MLflow
GitHub / GitLab
Terraform / CloudFormation
Model monitoring and governance
Data & Integration
Experience working with:
Structured and unstructured datasets
Data preprocessing and feature engineering
SQL / NoSQL databases
REST APIs and microservices architecture
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working on enterprise AI transformation initiatives.
Exposure to Azure AI or multi-cloud environments is an added advantage.
Experience in deploying GenAI solutions in production environments.
Knowledge of vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, or OpenSearch.
Familiarity with Responsible AI and AI governance frameworks.
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Educational Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in:
Computer Science
Artificial Intelligence
Data Science
Information Technology
Related Engineering discipline
Preferred Certifications
AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty
AWS Certified Solutions Architect
AWS Certified DevOps Engineer
Generative AI related certifications
Soft Skills
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Excellent communication and presentation abilities
Ability to work in fast-paced agile environments
Leadership and mentoring capabilities
Strong client-facing and collaboration skills
Key Expectations
Ability to independently drive AI initiatives from design to deployment.
Capability to architect scalable AI solutions aligned with business goals.
Strong ownership mindset and commitment to delivery excellence.
Ability to work with global teams and enterprise stakeholders.
